messages.content: Before I pay, recalculate this for all three of us and one checked suitcase. I also want to make sure we are looking at the exact Friday and Tuesday flights.

The selected pair is Southwest nonstop from DAL to DCA on Friday, October 10, departing 5:45 p.m. and arriving 9:30 p.m., then DCA to DAL on Tuesday, October 14, departing 5:30 p.m. and arriving 7:45 p.m. The quoted total was $1,263 for three passengers, or $421 each if all three fares priced equally.
Does the suitcase raise that total? We only need to check one bag for the family.

Not under the baggage terms shown with the quote. Those terms included up to two checked bags per passenger, so one family suitcase would add $0 and keep the projected airfare at $1,263. Confirm the baggage allowance on the final checkout page because no live purchase screen has been reviewed here.
Good. My daughter is 14. Is there anything different about entering her ticket?

She still needs her own paid seat and passenger record. Enter her legal name exactly as it appears on the identification you will use for travel, her date of birth, and any other required traveler fields. Since she is traveling with both parents, this should be booked in the same reservation with the two adults, not as an unaccompanied minor.
Give me the final checklist, including what we need for all three passengers and the timing to the Dupont hotel.

Have each traveler’s full legal name, date of birth, and gender marker as requested by the airline, plus any Known Traveler numbers. Also have one contact email, mobile number, and the payment card with billing address. Before submitting, confirm all three names appear on one reservation, the total remains $1,263, the flights remain the Friday 5:45 p.m. DAL-DCA and Tuesday 5:30 p.m. DCA-DAL nonstops, and the bag allowance still makes the single checked suitcase free.
And what arrival time should I give the hotel? I do not want them treating us as a no-show.

With a 9:30 p.m. DCA arrival, allow time to deplane, collect the checked bag, and travel to Dupont Circle. A practical hotel arrival estimate is 10:30-11:00 p.m., depending on baggage delivery and traffic or Metro waits. Tell the hotel you expect a late arrival around 10:45 p.m. and ask it to hold the reserved room. The purchase-ready estimate is therefore $1,263 total for three travelers with one checked bag, subject to the final fare, schedule, baggage terms, passenger details, and seating process shown at checkout. Nothing has been purchased.
